V – Cr – W – Zr alloy is characterized by strong inhomogeneity of the grain structure, with the grain sizes varying from 10 to 40 μ m ( Fig. 1 a).

There is no trace of rolling on the grain orientation map, and the grains of complex shape with curved bound - aries indicate incomplete recrystallization under the conditions of sta - bilizing annealing.
In V – Cr – Ta – Zr alloy after the same treatment, the grain structure retains the rolling legacy: the grains have an elongated shape in the rolling direction (RD) ( Fig. 1 d).
At the same time, the grain structure is more homogenous.
